prompt: Create a premium macro product photograph of Codex tokens: exactly 5 metallic silver coins on a glossy dark reflective surface, with 4 coins stacked horizontally on the left and 1 large coin standing upright and leaning slightly in front on the right. The upright coin dominates the composition and has a ridged edge, embossed concentric circular rings, the word CODEX spaced across the top rim, and BUILD THE FUTURE curved along the bottom rim. In the center of each visible coin, emboss a rounded-square app-icon panel containing a cloud-shaped outline with a command prompt chevron and short underscore line, like a terminal symbol inside a cloud. The stacked coins should show ribbed edges and partial top engravings, with the top stack coin also showing the same logo and faint rim text. Use cool blue and violet studio lighting, polished brushed-metal material, crisp engraved details, shallow depth of field, soft bloom highlights, and a smooth gradient background from deep navy on the left to pale electric blue on the right. Make it look like a high-end cryptocurrency/token advertisement, square 1:1 composition, photorealistic 3D render, no people, no extra objects, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张高端微距产品摄影图，主体为 Codex 代币：在光亮的深色反射表面上放置 5 枚金属银币，左侧水平堆叠 4 枚，右侧前方立着 1 枚较大的硬币并略微倾斜。立着的硬币占据构图主体，具有齿状边缘、压印的同心圆环，顶部边缘刻有 CODEX，底部边缘弧形刻有 BUILD THE FUTURE。在每枚可见硬币的中心，压印一个圆角方形的应用图标面板，其中包含一个云朵轮廓，云朵内有一个命令行提示符（chevron）和短下划线，类似于云端的终端符号。堆叠的硬币应显示出齿状边缘和局部的顶部雕刻，最上方的硬币也应显示相同的标志和模糊的边缘文字。使用冷蓝色和紫色的工作室灯光，抛光拉丝金属材质，清晰的雕刻细节，浅景深，柔和的泛光高光，以及从左侧深海军蓝到右侧淡电光蓝的平滑渐变背景。使其看起来像高端加密货币/代币广告，1:1 正方形构图，逼真的 3D 渲染，无人像，无额外物体，无水印。
